title: Jammy Crisp Dutch Cheese Fritters
description: A date-night Dutch dish featuring shredded Mexican cheese and tadka, crispy on the outside and jammy on the inside. Perfect for a romantic evening treat.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: gluten-free flour substitute recommended for stricter dietary requirements

ingredients.name: tadka oil
ingredients.notes: a mixture of vegetable oil and spices, traditionally used in Indian cuisine

ingredients.name: cornstarch
ingredients.notes: for dusting the fritters before frying

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.notes: balances the savory flavors of the cheese

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, and spices until well combined.
Add the grated cheese and mix until the cheese is evenly distributed throughout the flour mixture.
Gradually add the tadka oil to the cheese mixture, stirring until the dough comes together in a ball.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat about 1/2 inch of tadka oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the dough circles to the skillet and fry until they are golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and dust with cornstarch before serving.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining dough circles.
